items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did a television show for the engagement, and Ralph Ellison was the announcer on the show.

ctx.x: Yeah. We did record in a…. there was one album. It was called “Music That Should Have Been Played In Monterey” or something. We recorded that. It came out, and we never got paid for it. Mingus recorded it secretively. Howard Johnson and I, after we were fired off the bandstand in Los Angeles at Royce Hall, were walking around and we walked down in the basement and the lights were on so we went back to this room. There was this big recording equipment, and they’re recording the concert. They say, “Well, this is…
